title: Connect to an unreachable loopback SSH machine, see its error, reconnect, keep working locally, then disconnect and forget only that machine
preconditions: private scratch config with no saved machine
a fresh launch: one window, one workspace, one terminal tab, the home session only

steps.note: Connect to Machine… with a destination: an SSH machine is saved and its session joins the home session; a script run offers no install
ssh to port 1 is refused: the machine's session is not connected and the sidebar's machine row says why
Reconnect Machine on the only SSH machine: it tries again and fails the same way
the local workspace keeps working while the remote machine fails: a new local terminal tab
Disconnect Machine: the SSH machine stops trying and stays in the list
Forget Machine: only the SSH machine the case added goes; a script run has no undo toast

invariants: the remote machine's failure is explicit: its session is never connected, and its state and the sidebar row name the failure rather than hiding the machine
the local workspace, its terminals and its focus are the same at launched and local-only except for local-new-tab's tab: the remote machine never changes a local surface
forget removes only the session connect added; the home session keeps its id
every mutation has one receipt or one typed error (I1)
ids stay stable unless the step created or closed them (I2)
teardown: quit the tagged app the run started
verify its debug socket is gone
untested: a reachable remote cmux-tui: an offline case has no SSH server; a loopback sshd fixture is not part of the corpus yet
latency on a live remote link and its heartbeat: the machine never connects
a remote workspace and closing its surfaces: they exist only once the machine connects
the authorization of remote relay requests: relay policy is covered by the daemon-ops and cli suites
